title: Senior Account Executive, Strategic Accounts  UK&I + Northern Europe
description: <p>Since landing in EMEA in 2022, Airtable has built a full go-to-market function in the region and is now accelerating its next phase of growth. Our expansion includes a move to our fabulous new EMEA HQ at Borough Yards in London, alongside launching  on-the-ground teams in France and Germany. Already, we power some of the world's leading FTSE 100, CAC 40, and DAX 40 brands—and we’re just getting started. </p> <p>Each client has unique business needs and you will act as a trusted business advisor to understand their specific business pains and map them to Airtable solutions. You will work cross-functionally with our EMEA-based team of BDRs, Solutions Consulting, Services, Customer Success, Partnerships and Marketing to generate pipeline, map out solutions and ensure long-term success for new and existing customers. </p> <h1><strong>What you'll do</strong></h1> <ul> <li>Own the full sales cycle for your book of business across Northern Europe - prospect, develop, manage and close.</li> <li>Leverage MEDDICC and Command of the Message to effectively qualify deals, build champions and forecast accurately.</li> <li>Educate current and prospective customers on the value proposition of Airtable’s Connected Applications Platform.</li> <li>Partner with Customer Success Managers and other cross-functional teams our to grow and renew existing accounts.</li> <li>Build relationships with senior stakeholders across all industries.</li> <li>Coordinate resources throughout the sales cycle including legal, sales engineering, implementation specialists and sales leadership.</li> </ul> <h1><strong>Who you are</strong></h1> <ul> <li>7+ years of quota-carrying SaaS sales experience.</li> <li>4+ years selling into the Enterprise segment.</li> <li>Strong track-record of overachieving quota throughout your current tenure & career.</li> <li>Passionate about generating your own pipeline opportunities and landing new logos.</li> <li>AI Fluency: You operate with AI as a core part of how you work.</li> <li>Closed and owned complex deals with named accounts (5000+ FTEs) .</li> <li>Experience expanding initial use-cases across other teams and organizations within existing customers.</li> <li>Comfortable managing and navigating a variety of high-level stakeholders with a track-record of building trusted relationships.</li> <li>Trained in MEDDICC and/or Command of the Message.</li> <li>Preferred to have: Examples of closing AI uses cases into production with customers. </li> </ul> <h3><strong>What We Offer </strong></h3> <p>We believe great work starts with feeling supported, that’s why we’ve built a benefits package designed to help you thrive both inside and outside of work.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Strong £OTE, ramp up, and recoverable draw </strong></li> <li><strong>Travel</strong>: £7,500 annual allowance to cover your commute.</li> <li><strong>Healthcare</strong>: Top-tier private medical, dental, and vision coverage through AXA, with heavily subsidised plans available for dependants.</li> <li><strong>Family planning</strong>: Up to £7,200 per year through Carrot to support your path to parenthood, plus a minimum of 16 weeks fully paid maternity or paternity leave.</li> <li><strong>Childcare</strong>: Save up to 42% per child annually through our Workplace Nursery salary sacrifice scheme.</li> <li><strong>Pension & protection</strong>: 9% company pension contribution.</li> <li><strong>Health & wellness</strong>: £150 every month to spend on whatever helps you feel your best, from fitness and mindfulness to hobbies and self-care.</li> <li><strong>Free lunch</strong>: Enjoy a varied, catered lunch every day you’re in the office.</li> <li><strong>Home office</strong>: £750 one-off allowance to create a workspace that works for you.</li> <li><strong>Time off</strong>: 25 days annual leave, plus 4 company-wide Recharge Days and additional time off between Christmas and New Year as part of our Winter Break.</li> <li><strong>Give back</strong>: 5 paid Volunteer Days each year to support causes you care about, individually or with your team.</li> </ul> <p>At Airtable, we embrace diversity and strive to create a workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. We strive for Airtable to be a pleasant and supportive place to work, and to attract and retain a diverse team of talented people.  We take great pride in holding everyone accountable for treating each other with dignity and respect. </p> <p>Airtable is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If you have a medical condition or disability which inhibits your ability to complete any part of the application process, please complete our<a href="https://airtable.com/appwNpUUGOyO4KSne/shrBRUNVfrEIXsAZI"> Accommodations Request Form</a> and let us know how we may assist you.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Account Executive, Corporate
description: <p>As a Corporate Account Executive at Airtable you will have the opportunity to work closely with a variety of clients and accounts. Each client has unique needs and you act as a trusted business advisor, helping them effectively leverage our product to drive maximum impact for their business. </p> <p>Just like Lego blocks, what our customers can build with Airtable is virtually limitless. This opens up all sorts of exciting possibilities for our Sales team in terms of who our potential customer is. As a result, the demand for our product has outpaced the capacity of our sales team.</p> <p><em>Please note, this is a hybrid role based in London, England, UK.</em></p> <h1><strong>What you'll do</strong></h1> <ul> <li><strong>Pioneer the Future</strong>: Be the <strong>trailblazer</strong>—Make impact on the ground shaping our Corporate sales strategy and operations in various new regions.</li> <li><strong>Ownership & Autonomy</strong>: Enjoy full ownership of building and scaling the commercial and mid-market customer base, with the freedom to shape your approach and make a real impact.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Sales Cycle</strong>: Manage the end-to-end sales process—from discovery to close, including demos, negotiations, and building lasting relationships.</li> <li><strong>Shape Customer Success</strong>: Build <strong>trusted partnerships</strong> with key decision-makers and drive <strong>business transformation</strong> through our solutions.</li> <li>Become an Airtable product expert, delighting prospects with a phenomenal educational experience, and helping cross-functional teams with product feedback and user insights</li> </ul> <h1><strong>Who you are</strong></h1> <ul> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills</li> <li>3+ years in a SaaS sales role with a track record of success, minimum 2+ years closing experience</li> <li>Experience as a customer account manager as well as a new logo hunter</li> <li>Strong business acumen that includes prior experience managing multiple concurrent client relationships, anticipating change, adjusting priorities accordingly, and working effectively as a team</li> <li>Self-starter comfortable with some ambiguity, demonstrating a willingness to learn/ramp quickly and be a creative problem solver for the larger Airtable team</li> <li>You embody a growth mindset and seek out opportunities to constantly learn and grow. Extreme curiosity to learn about the product, the industry, and your customer’s businesses.</li> <li>Strong operational mindset, eager to build processes for yourself and the team to maximize productivity</li> <li>Bonus Points if French Speaking; There is an opportunity to cover the French region, including companies up to 3000 FTE. title: (Senior) Account Manager (Creative Automation)
description: <p><em><strong>This is a 12 month fixed term contract initially with strong likelihood of extension and a beginning of January 2027 start date.</strong></em></p> <p><em><strong>Please note that the internal job title for this role is TBC.</strong></em></p> <p><em>DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.</em></p> <p><strong>JOB PURPOSE</strong></p> <p><em>This role is part of our </em><strong><em>Global Studios</em></strong><em> team. We create emotive yet conversion-focused ideas, products and campaigns at scale and speed. Our specialty is hyper-personalised, digital communications that change perceptions, shape new behaviours, and shift market share for our clients.</em></p> <p>As part of DEPT’s Creative Automation team, you will bridge design teams, project management, and technical execution. In this role, you will lead creative automation campaigns, oversee integrated deliveries, and support hands-on data feed setup using Google Sheets to power our automated workflows. Working closely with designers, Creative Automation specialists, developers, account managers and external stakeholders, you will translate campaign briefs into efficient data schemas, streamline production pipelines, and ensure high-impact creative execution while maintaining agency profitability and technical integrity. </p> <p>If you’re adept at problem-solving within data sets, have a passion for streamlining workflows, and are excited by the intersection of design and technology, this role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to a highly relevant and evolving field.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bridge the gap between non-technical client service teams and technical specialists, helping colleagues understand the capabilities and limitations of creative automation systems.</li> <li>Lead requirements gathering for data feeds and briefing documents with internal and external stakeholders, asking the critical questions needed to design robust schemas.</li> <li>Build, manage, and debug data feeds from scratch using advanced Google Sheets formulas, ensuring configurations are streamlined, error-proof, and easy for cross-functional teams to use.</li> <li>Design user-friendly, structured input documents for client data collection that minimize data-entry errors and simplify maintenance.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with automation designers to align data feeds with design templates, running rigorous QA testing to prevent production and rendering errors.</li> <li>Continuously improve ways of working and processes in data feeds and cloud rendering to ensure efficiency and ongoing optimisation.</li> <li>Oversee end-to-end delivery of multiple integrated and automated campaigns, ensuring all projects are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget.</li> <li>Distill and translate client feedback into clear, actionable direction for designers, copywriters, and developers.</li> <li>Build and cultivate strong client relationships through video conferences, briefing sessions, and campaign evaluation reviews.</li> <li>Partner with the team to review, test, and deploy final creative assets across client-owned channels.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT YOU BRING</strong></p> <ul> <li>High proficiency in spreadsheets with advanced Google Sheets formula skills and an aptitude for mastering custom formulas and data manipulation.</li> <li>Strong foundational grasp of relational databases, data normalization, and data-entry error prevention.</li> <li>Proven track record delivering multi-channel marketing campaigns across digital and direct channels, such as dynamic display banners, social, and email.</li> <li>Strong relationship management skills with the confidence to advise clients, partner with external suppliers, and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.</li> <li>Exceptional organizational and scheduling abilities to balance competing priorities, manage tight turnaround times, and hit deadlines consistently.</li> <li>Sharp attention to detail with an uncompromising standard for quality control across both data and creative output.</li> <li>Outstanding oral and written communication skills, skilled at translating technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and internal teams.</li> <li>Innate curiosity and drive to optimize processes, streamline workflows, and grow within a fast-evolving discipline.</li> </ul> <p><em>Nice to have:</em></p> <ul> <li>Prior experience with creative automation tools and a working understanding of the creative production pipeline (e.g., Adobe After Effects, cloud/AWS rendering, and interactive production).</li> </ul> <p><strong>WE OFFER</strong></p> <ul> <li>A flexible hybrid working policy to enjoy the best of both worlds (2 days from the office, depending on location).</li> <li>Early Finish Fridays, kickstart your weekend early with alternating early-finish Fridays.</li> <li>26 days paid holiday, plus UK Bank Holidays.</li> <li>Access to dedicated mental health resources including enhanced sick pay scheme, employee assistance programme and trained Mental Health First Aiders. </li> <li>Company Pension Scheme. </li> <li>Access to a Private Medical Insurance or Cash Plan scheme. </li> <li>Season Ticket Loan, interest-free Season Ticket Loans to help spread the cost of travel.</li> <li>Cycle to Work Scheme, save money on a new bike and equipment.</li> <li>EV Car Scheme, access to an electric vehicle via a salary sacrifice arrangement.</li> <li>Enhanced family-friendly policies to support parents.</li> <li>Workplace Nursery Scheme, save on childcare by paying for nursery fees through a tax-efficient salary sacrifice scheme. </li> <li>DEPT® Allowance, a dedicated company contribution to spend on either your professional development or personal wellbeing.</li> <li>Social and Cultural Events, plenty of opportunities to connect with colleagues through organised activities and celebrations.</li> <li>Learning and Development, continuous growth opportunities through internal training, and "inspirational talks” guest speakers.</li> <li>Buddy Program, you will be paired with a ‘Buddy’ to help you navigate your first weeks’ at DEPT®.</li> <li>A Certified BCorp Agency and is multi-award winning “Agency of the Year”. </li> <li>Awesome clients. Whether big or small, local or global, at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with clients of all sizes and across all industries. And we celebrate all of our successes together!</li> <li>Global <a href="https://www.deptagency.com/dept-cares-day-2023/">DEPT® Cares Month</a>, an annual initiative where our teams donate their professional skills and time to support local charities and pr-bono projects.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHY DEPT®?</strong></p> <p>We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.</p> <p>We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. title: Software Engineer, Research Platform
description: Software Engineer, Research Platform About Us Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData and our Trillion Gene Atlas (TGA), the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development. In September 2026 we closed an oversubscribed $140M Series C led by S32, with participation from NVIDIA, Anthropic's Anthology Fund, Catalio, European Tech Collective, Firebrand River Capital, King Philanthropies, NATO Innovation Fund, NVentures (NVIDIA's venture arm), Redalpine, Rockefeller Foundation, Singular, Sovereign AI and True Ventures. At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today. The Role We're seeking an exceptional Software Engineer, Research Platform to join our team in London, embedded in our AI, genomics and computational biology teams. Your goal is to accelerate their research by bringing production-grade engineering to the systems they depend on. This is an embedded role. You'll sit with the scientists, understand what they are trying to find out, and build the systems that get them there faster: making research code reliable, reproducible and fast; designing data pipelines and workflows that run at the scale of BaseData and the Trillion Gene Atlas; and building the tools and infrastructure that let a small research team run far more experiments. You'll move between genomics, computational biology and ML work as the research requires, and own what you build end to end. The engineering problems are substantial: petascale biological data, workflows that span cloud and HPC, and research that is often limited by how quickly an idea can be turned into a result. You'll report to the Head of Platform as part of our engineering team, which spans London and Boston, and work day to day within the AI research, genomics and computational biology teams in London. About you A very strong engineering background: complex production systems you have designed, built and owned. Expert in Python; strong habits around testing, code review and CI/CD. A solid understanding of data pipelines, workflow orchestration, distributed execution and scalable compute (Kubernetes, HPC, containers). You can take a researcher's code, understand the question behind it, and make it robust without losing what made it useful. A real interest in biology, ideally with experience of genomic, protein or sequencing data. You will learn the science well enough to understand the research, not just its code. Collaborative and low ego. We care about drive, and in a small team everyone depends on what you build. Nice to have Research or applied experience in computational biology, bioinformatics or genomics. Experience with bioinformatics tooling and sequencing data at scale. Familiarity with Dagster or similar orchestration, Kubernetes, cloud and HPC compute. Experience building tools, MCP servers or workflows that AI agents and researchers use to run computational experiments. What we offer in return Impactful Mission: This is a rare chance to do work that genuinely matters. You'll join a talented, fast-moving team, access unique biological datasets at scale, and see your contributions shape real breakthroughs in AI and curative therapeutics. Collaborative Culture: You'll be surrounded by world-class engineers, scientists, and researchers who care deeply about their work and about each other. With offices in London and Boston, we've built a flexible, cross-functional environment where personal development and real ownership aren't just talking points. High Growth: We truly believe in investing in our top talent, we make coaching available to team members during steep growth journeys and we have twice yearly promotion opportunities. title: Customer and Client Support Specialist
description: About Us Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities. We run camera-based parking for landowners and operators, from hotels and colleges to shopping centres, across England, Scotland and Wales. With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country. Role Overview We’re looking for a Customer and Client Support Specialist to join our support team in Croydon. You’ll help two groups of people: the drivers who park at our sites, and the landowners and asset managers we work with. Most of the job is email, through Zendesk. This isn’t answering from an FAQ. A good reply means reading the message properly, working out what’s actually being asked, checking the facts across our systems, and writing an answer that solves the problem without creating a new one. Some drivers will be angry, and some will be wrong but loud. We need someone who stays calm, gets it right, and follows up until it’s fixed. It’s a role for a “learn-it-all” who cares about getting small things right, ticket after ticket. Almost everything is teachable in your first couple of months, and there’s plenty of room to grow as the company does. Key Responsibilities Respond to driver and client enquiries by email, clearly, accurately and on time. Investigate each case properly before replying, checking details such as references, tariffs and permit lists. Keep accurate records of every interaction. Work with TechOps, Client Success and other teams on the trickier cases, and chase until they’re resolved. Spot issues that keep coming up and flag them to the team, rather than just closing your own ticket. Help build out and improve our processes as the team grows. Who we’re looking for You’ll need: Experience in a customer support or service role. Excellent written English: clear, polite, accurate and free of typos, with the right tone for the situation. A real eye for detail. You read carefully, check before you reply and notice when something doesn’t add up. Calm under pressure, including with rude or unfair customers. The ability to manage a busy queue and several priorities at once. Ownership: you close loops, chase what’s stuck and ask when there’s no clear answer. Openness to feedback and a willingness to learn. The ability to work independently and as part of a team. Nice to have: Experience with Zendesk and Jira. Experience in parking, mobility, utilities or another high-volume consumer service. What We Offer Hybrid working: 3 days in the office, 2 days from home. Room to grow with the business, with training, mentorship and exposure to technical operations. 20 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays. Company pension scheme. A fully refurbished, modern office right next to East Croydon Station, with a fully stocked kitchen offering free breakfast, lunch and drinks (and two office dogs!). Laptop and tech provided. Employee Assistance Programme, BrightHR Exchange discounts and regular company events. The details Location: Croydon, next to East Croydon Station. Hybrid: 3 days in the office, 2 from home. description: We’re hiring an analyst to open first conversations with investors who are new to Pairs, and to book their meetings with the founders we work with. You have a strong track record of leading complex, cross-functional programmes end-to-end, from scoping and sequencing to delivery across multiple stakeholders. We are committed to being a flexible employer, as we understand you don't have to be in the office to do your best work, however this role is based in London (Shoreditch) and ideally you will be able to join us in the office 3 days per week . Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose. title: Finance Analyst
description: At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table. Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand. Job Description Reporting to our Financial Planning and Analytics Director, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the way our Finance team manages and interprets financial data. This is a unique opportunity to influence decision-making across the business, helping to drive sustainable growth and operational efficiency through structured, insightful analysis. Please note that this role is initially offered as a six-month fixed-term position . You will join a lean, collaborative FP&A team and contribute to building a new way of working, where data is clean, accessible, and actionable. You will be part of transformative projects, including system migrations, which will redefine our financial processes and reporting capabilities. Responsibilities Clean, transform, and organise large volumes of financial data from multiple systems into a structured format suitable for analysis. Extract and manage data from ERP and finance systems, including Sage, Adaptive (from Workday), Salesforce, Certinia, and Melon, ensuring consistency and reliability. Collaborate closely with Operations and other stakeholders to aggregate and interpret data for reporting and decision-making purposes. Conduct detailed financial analysis, variance reporting, and forecasting to support senior management in strategic planning. Build accurate, actionable reports and dashboards that provide clear insights to senior stakeholders. Support the development of greater process, structure, and discipline in financial data management and reporting across the business. Work proactively to meet deadlines, balancing multiple priorities and ensuring data integrity. Qualifications Over 2 years’ experience in financial planning, analysis (FP&A), and forecasting, with hands-on experience extracting data from ERP systems. Strong financial knowledge, with the ability to interpret financial data. Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate raw data into reports and actionable insights, and to inform decisions and develop business strategies. Structured approach to streamline and automate processes while maintaining data integrity. You’re great at collaborating with team members to achieve common goals, valuing and respecting diverse contributions. Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English. Additional Information Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs. 💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours. 👪 Family Support: Enjoy 14 weeks of paid leave for primary caregivers and 4 weeks of paid leave for secondary caregivers. We also provide £1000 (or equivalent) towards courses for returning primary caregivers to support your transition back into work. Unfortunately, there has been an increase in fake recruiters impersonating Jellyfish and unlawfully using our brand name. title: Solutions Lead
description: About Ramp Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. About the role We’re looking for a Solutions Lead to help build Ramp’s solutions function for our international business, starting with the UK and Europe. This is a hands-on builder role. You’ll be a trusted technical partner to prospects, customers and channel partners, shaping how we sell, implement and support complex solutions as the business grows. This is broader than a traditional pre-sales role. Winning complex opportunities is central to the job, but your impact won’t end at signature. You’ll connect technical discovery with implementation readiness, help resolve high-stakes customer challenges, enable partners, and build the demos, playbooks and technical expertise that make the wider team more effective. You’ll combine technical depth, commercial judgement and a strong understanding of finance workflows to solve the most important problems yourself and build repeatable approaches so the business becomes less dependent on any one person. You don’t need an engineering background; what matters is your ability to understand systems, solve technical problems and communicate clearly. You’ll also have the opportunity to help customers navigate an evolving platform, including areas such as Accounts Receivable, Stack and our AI-powered products: Router, Glass and Inspect. What you’ll do: Win complex opportunities and prepare them for implementation Partner with Account Executives and Account Managers to lead technical discovery, tailored demos and solution design, translating finance and procurement requirements into practical workflows and integrations. Communicate capabilities, gaps and trade-offs clearly; identify implementation risks early and establish clear ownership and dated handoffs to the implementation team. Lead technical resolution of complex customer challenges Diagnose high-impact product, configuration, accounting and ERP issues, coordinating with customer-facing and technical teams to drive a clear resolution path. Turn recurring issues into better guidance and evidence-backed product feedback, rather than a permanent stream of one-off interventions. Enable partners and build the international solutions function Act as the technical counterpart to channel and accounting partners, supporting joint opportunities and equipping them with reusable knowledge and resources. Partnerships retains ownership of commercial relationships and partner strategy. Work with Demo Architecture and Solutions teams to build market-relevant demos, playbooks and enablement for AEs, AMs and partners. Use lightweight intake and prioritisation to focus effort on customer risk, revenue impact and opportunities for leverage. What you need A strong track record, typically 5–7 years, in solutions consulting, sales engineering, solutions architecture or technical consulting for complex B2B software, or in accounting or an in-house finance role with relevant systems and technical problem-solving experience. Experience leading discovery, explaining complex workflows or systems, and influencing decisions across multiple stakeholders; experience delivering tailored demos is valuable. Strong understanding of finance and accounting workflows, with hands-on experience working with ERP or accounting systems and their integrations. The ability to reason through APIs, data flows and configuration dependencies, investigate technical problems and translate your findings for technical and non-technical audiences. Evidence of working beyond the sale: designing implementable solutions, navigating complex customer issues and collaborating effectively across commercial and technical teams. A builder’s mindset, with examples of creating reusable tools, documentation, demos or enablement that improved how others work. Sound judgement about where to go deep, when to bring in specialists and how to set boundaries across competing priorities. Comfort operating independently in an evolving market while building strong relationships with regional colleagues and central teams. Nice to have Experience with fintech, spend management, procurement or procure-to-pay platforms. Familiarity with UK and European accounting practices, multi-entity structures and multi-currency workflows. Experience enabling accounting firms, channel partners or implementation partners. Experience building or scaling a solutions motion in a new market. SQL, scripting or other practical technical problem-solving skills. What success looks like In your first 6–12 months, you’ll establish a trusted technical path for complex opportunities and customer escalations; clearer procurement scoping and implementation handoffs; and stronger technical capability across our partner ecosystem. You’ll also build reusable demos, enablement and playbooks that let the region scale without requiring you in every conversation, supported by clear visibility into solutions demand and outcomes. title: Software Engineer II - React Native - Consumer Growth
description: Building the Future of Open Finance Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. The team Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. The opportunity Consumer Growth helps customers get more value from the Kraken app. We improve how people discover relevant features, build confidence using them, and keep coming back. We work closely with Product, Design and Data to understand customer behavior, identify opportunities and test ideas. Our engineers help shape what we build. You’ll bring ideas to the table, challenge assumptions and own your work from the initial hypothesis through launch, measurement and iteration. Ship fast experiments, from a couple of days to a couple of weeks, to improve conversion and retention in the Kraken app. Find funnel drop-offs and turn them into testable ideas, then build, measure and iterate. Design, develop and maintain high-quality React Native features for our consumer mobile app. Help customers discover and adopt relevant features through improvements to customer journeys, incentives and A/B tests. Use AI to build quickly, then review and ship with a high quality bar. Deliver polished, user-friendly UI that makes the product feel great to use. Build for correctness, accessibility, performance and reliability, with testing appropriate to the change. Work closely with Product, Design, Data and Backend Engineering to define hypotheses and measure results. Instrument your work so the team can evaluate customer behavior and experiment results, and use what you learn to improve, expand or stop an experiment. Turn successful experiments into reliable, maintainable product experiences. Proactively spot gaps and opportunities, and take ownership of the outcome. What you bring Strong experience building production mobile apps with React Native and TypeScript. A product and growth mindset, focused on moving metrics rather than just shipping code. Evidence of product impact: you can explain what you built, why you built it and what you learned after launch. Curiosity about data, and comfort using analytics tools such as Mixpanel and Segment. Experience working in a scale-up or other high-growth, fast-moving environment. Fluency in using AI tools to build, review and ship code, while retaining ownership of engineering decisions and the quality of the result. A strong eye for UI quality and polish. A self-directed approach, with the confidence to find problems and fix them without being asked. Comfort working from an ambiguous customer problem, proposing ideas and finding a small, useful change to test. Collaborative working style across Product, Design and Engineering. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Nice to haves Hands-on experience running A/B tests and experiments, ideally with Statsig or a similar tool. Experience with large-scale consumer products used by millions of people. Agency or consulting background shipping across multiple products. Experience in consumer fintech, payments or crypto apps. Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. title: Creative Strategist & Producer - Consumer
description: Building the Future of Open Finance Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. The team Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, 2D and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships. The opportunity Great creative starts with a sharp idea, and the earlier it arrives, the better the work gets. As our Creative Strategist & Producer, you bring ideas in at the start of a campaign and you can also make them. Up to half the role is writing complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, and sometimes organic and social, then briefing them into our creatives and designers. The other half is making work yourself, in whatever format you’re strongest at. You also help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing write stronger briefs of their own. This role is for a proactive self-starter. Nobody will hand you the idea: you go and find it, pitch it and get it made. You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You work daily with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, who bring deep knowledge of the product and the media channels, and with the creatives who bring your briefs to life. Spot opportunities in culture every day. Watch pop culture, trends, competitors, comments and performance data, and turn what you find into ideas we ship the same week. Stay close to financial markets and to Kraken’s audience. Write complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, built with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, and brief them into the performance creatives and designers. Help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing managers sharpen their own briefs, bringing the concept, the hook and the cultural angle to the start of the process. Pitch original concepts for paid and social before anyone asks, so ideas reach the team already sharp. Make your own content for paid and organic. The format is open: you could be a meme machine, an AI video specialist, someone who performs to camera, or something we haven’t thought of. What matters is that it feels native to the feed and ships fast. Use performance data and social listening as creative input, and get more distinct angles into tests each month.Performance Marketing owns test design and readouts; you own the creative response. React inside the news cycle. You spot the moment, and you brief it or make it yourself. Partner with Product Marketing and compliance to get work approved without losing the idea. Keep your briefs and files clean enough for other people to build on. What you bring 5+ years in creative strategy, social, content or performance creative at a high-volume in-house team, brand or agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category. A portfolio submitted with your application. Include two or three concept-led briefs or concept decks, with what shipped and how it performed where you’re able to share it, plus work you made yourself in the formats that are your strength. Include one idea you spotted in culture or data and took to market, with a short note on what the results told you and what you changed. A proactive, self-starting way of working. You find the idea, pitch it and drive it to be shipped without waiting to be asked, and you’re comfortable owning your workflow with light direction. Pop-culture fluency and a chronically online persona, with comedic instinct and a sense for what’s about to feel dated. A performance marketer’s grip on what a good brief needs: a clear objective, audience, hook, platform, format and set of constraints, and the ability to coach others toward it. A creative superpower you can execute on alone, with shipped work to show for it. Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit and X. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one. Fluency in the metrics creative moves, and the habit of using performance data and social listening as inputs to ideas. A solid copywriting instinct. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon. Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with concepts that survive risk warnings and market-specific requirements. Speed without sloppiness. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2>About the role</h2> <p>Every change to Anthropic's software has to reach production somehow: new code, runtime configuration, feature flags, infrastructure changes. Our team builds the systems those changes travel through. Our mission is to give every team at Anthropic a fast, safe, and predictable path from change to production.</p> <p>You'll join the team within Anthropic's Infrastructure organization that owns pipelines, staged rollouts, health-gated promotion, and rollback, along with runtime configuration, feature flags, and the systems that deliver code and artifacts to machines across a very large fleet. You'll own a meaningful part of this end to end, from design through operating it in production.</p> <p>If you want your work to shape how fast and how safely Anthropic ships, this could be a great fit.</p> <h2>Key responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Set technical direction for major parts of the deployment platform and own them end to end: design, implementation, operations, and on-call</li> <li>Build rollout safety into the platform, including progressive delivery, health-gated promotion, automatic pause and rollback, and deploy controls that teams manage themselves</li> <li>Design APIs and abstractions that work equally well for engineers and for AI agents</li> <li>Extend the platform to new workload types and runtimes, from Kubernetes to serverless and edge platforms</li> <li>Build description: About HIVED 📦 At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing. Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery. A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better. Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market. Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures , Maersk Growth , Pale Blue Dot VC , Eka Ventures , NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery. Role Overview 📝 We're looking for a Senior or Staff ML / Operations Research Engineer to take on some of the hardest problems at HIVED: the planning systems that decide how every parcel moves through our 100% electric delivery network. You'll join the Routing Squad , which owns HIVED's entire planning pipeline: demand forecasting, capacity planning and scheduling, sortation, our collections network and large-scale route optimisation. You'll design the optimisation, forecasting and ML models at the core of it, and bring them into production together with backend engineers, data scientists, analysts and our operations teams. This is a hands-on role with a lot of technical ownership. You'll shape how we model the network and your work shows up in the routes our drivers take, the cages filled at our depots and the parcels that arrive on time. The problems are as varied as they are hard. How much volume will each depot see next week, and how many drivers and vehicles do we need to meet it? How should parcels flow through sortation and our collections network so nothing is handled twice? How do we turn each day's parcels into routes that are efficient, reliable and on time? And how do we model the cost and geography of our network as we expand into new cities? What You'll Be Doing 🚀 Build the models. Design and implement optimisation models and algorithms for routing, supply-demand matching, capacity planning and other core logistics challenges. Turn ambiguity into models. Take complex operational problems, break them down, and see them through from first investigation to production. Put models into production. Build and productionise optimisation, forecasting and ML models with our backend engineers, making them robust, observable and ready for peak volumes. Explore new approaches. Lead the exploration and evaluation of new approaches, from linear programming and heuristics to machine learning-based optimisation. Stay close to the operation. Work directly with operations teams, see how plans perform on the ground, and close the loop with data. Raise the bar. Lead design and code reviews, mentor engineers, and set the standards for how we test and evaluate our models. What We're Looking For 🔎 Typically 5+ years of experience building optimisation or ML models and shipping them into production systems. A track record of technical ownership beyond your own work: you've shaped the modelling approach or direction of systems spanning multiple components or teams. The ability to translate complex, ambiguous operational problems into technical solutions with measurable impact. Solid coding skills: Python preferred, though experience in other languages like C++, Java or Go is also valued. An appetite for hard optimisation problems: routing, scheduling, forecasting, supply-demand matching, or other constraint-heavy domains. Strong collaboration and written communication skills, with the confidence to work across engineering, data science, analytics and operations. You also bring depth in at least one of: Optimisation / operations research: linear and integer programming, constraint programming or heuristics, and integrating solvers such as OR-Tools or Gurobi into production systems. Machine learning: forecasting and predictive models that feed planning decisions, from development to monitoring in production. Technologies We Use 💻 Python, Go AWS (Lambda, ECS Fargate, Step Functions, SQS, EventBridge, Aurora PostgreSQL), CDK (TypeScript) GCP, BigQuery, Looker Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Prometheus GitHub, GitHub Actions Claude Code Event-driven architecture and domain-driven design Our interviewing process 🪜 Intro call with the hiring manager Live coding challenge solving a problem A take home case study, followed by a discussion On-site interview at our Shoreditch HQ (role and culture) Our Values 😊 We Are Kind - Kind to the planet, our team and our partners. We listen with purpose, leave our egos at the door and aren't afraid to make difficult decisions. We must never confuse kindness with being "nice" - it requires us to be fair, consistent, honest, thoughtful and compassionate. 🤝 We Are Tenacious - We fight every day to keep the customer promise, for every parcel entrusted to us. No matter how hard it gets or whatever stands in our way, we are relentless in our pursuit of excellence. 💡 We Are Curious - We never settle, constantly challenge convention and are never afraid to ask why. We believe there is always more to learn, always a better way, and that we're always only just getting started. We never fight the urge to be inquisitive, to understand the world around us and to explore where others might not. 🌍 We Are Resourceful - Our planet's resources are scarce and our future depends on our ability to use them wisely. Waste is the enemy. We strive to do more with less, be more efficient and make the most of what we have. How we reward our team 🎁 Dynamic hybrid working environment with a diverse and driven team Huge opportunity for learning in a high growth environment, with progression opportunities based on success in the role 25 days of holiday allowance plus public holidays 1 Birthday Day Off + 2 Tenure-Based Additional Days Off Subsidised Private Medical Insurance including dental, vision & mental health therapy Bi-annual performance reviews and tailored development plans Competitive salary + EMI options scheme Annual compensation review Team lunch provided once a week Quarterly team socials and annual sports day (HIVED Olympics) Enhanced maternity/paternity/adoption policy as day 1 right Community volunteer days Cycle to work scheme Dog friendly office and depots MacBook Air or Windows Laptop (depending on your preference) 🔍 Want to learn more? title: Network Production Engineer
description: About Fluidstack We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI. We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply! How We Operate Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role. Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible. Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins. Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward. Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world. The Production Engineering Team Examples of key problems the team is working on Turn every network fault from a mystery into a closed ticket. Link diagnostics across router to router and NIC to router paths, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows what's broken and why, because at 10s of GW scale debugging has to be systematic, not artisanal. Build the network repair pipeline that runs itself. Automated fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver lifecycle tracking, and return to service, across DC fabric, edge, and host to network layers, because a new site comes online every six months and manual repair doesn't keep up. Build the network monitoring platform for a fleet that never stops growing. Alerting lifecycle and health dashboards for infrastructure spanning multiple hyperscale sites today and 10s of GW next year. It doesn't exist yet. We're building it. Role Scope Carry the on-call pager for the network fleet and run repair end to end: diagnose the fault, execute the fix or drive the RMA, and return the link to service across DC fabric, edge, and host to network layers. Write Python and Go tooling that replaces manual diagnosis, including link tests, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows what's broken and why, so faults resolve in minutes, not hours. Automate the repair pipeline from fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver and optics tracking, and return to service, so a failure at any site follows the same path without manual handoffs. Maintain the realtime monitoring and alerting that gives every on-call engineer a true picture of network health across all sites, and keep it accurate as new sites and hardware roll in. Validate new sites and hardware into production by running the qualification tests that confirm a network is healthy before it carries traffic. What We're Looking For The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would. You've carried a pager for a production network and can walk into an outage, find the fault, fix it or drive the RMA, and write the postmortem without someone walking you through it. You've written Python or Go scripts that replaced a manual, repetitive network task, from link diagnostics to config pushes to fleet-wide command execution. You understand how a transceiver fault, a misconfigured route, and a power event each show up differently in the data, and you can tell them apart from the signals alone. You've worked hands-on with link diagnostics, optics, and network monitoring protocols such as gNMI, gRPC, NETCONF, and SONiC, and you're comfortable at the CLI on switches and routers across a fleet. You treat toil as a bug. If a repair step means SSHing into ten boxes by hand, you script it once and never do it by hand again. You reach real competence in an unfamiliar part of the stack fast, and you document what you learn so the next on-call engineer doesn't start from zero. Bonus: RMA and repair lifecycle automation. Large-scale datacenter fabric (BGP, ECMP, spine-leaf). Out-of-band network management. Fluency with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor to move faster on scripts and tooling. Salary & Benefits Competitive total compensation package (salary + equity). Retirement or pension plan, in line with local norms. Health, dental, and vision insurance. title: Tech Lead - Terminals
description: About Ryft Ryft is a regulated payment facilitator and authorised payment institution building the infrastructure layer for modern commerce platforms. We are now entering the next phase of scale, expanding into new verticals and building a category-defining embedded payments platform. About the Job Are you an engineering leader who wants to own the systems that connect physical point-of-sale hardware to a modern, scalable payments platform? We are looking for a Tech Lead to head up our Card Present (In-Person Payments) squad. You will lead the technical direction and hands-on delivery of the infrastructure that allows our merchants to take physical payments. You'll work across our C#/.NET backend on AWS, shaping how physical card taps and inserts securely communicate with our event-driven services, split funds, and settle correctly. You won't just be managing a Jira board, you'll be deep in the architecture, writing code, mentoring your squad, and owning the technical strategy for our physical terminal estate. What You'll Work On In-person payments architecture: Leading the technical design for our card-present estate, ensuring low-latency, highly reliable communication between physical terminals and our AWS backend. Terminal & Gateway Integration: Building the critical paths that connect smart payment terminals and Point of Sale (POS) systems into Ryft’s core gateway and marketplace routing logic. Hardware-to-cloud flows: Handling the unique complexities of physical payments: offline modes, state synchronization, hardware webhooks, and complex failure modes. Security & Compliance pipelines: Ensuring our physical payment flows remain airtight and fully compliant within heavily regulated environments. Squad Leadership: Setting the technical standard for the Card Present squad. Breaking down complex product requirements into actionable architecture and guiding engineers through delivery. The platform itself: Contributing to our broader event-driven C#/.NET service estate, infrastructure-as-code, and observability tooling alongside other Tech Leads. Responsibilities Lead technical delivery: Architect, build, and ship end-to-end features for our card-present offering. You are the ultimate technical owner of what your squad ships. Design for hardware-cloud correctness: Write and architect services that behave under network drops, partial failure, and hardware concurrency. Idempotency and absolute accuracy are the job, not edge cases. Raise the bar & mentor: Improve the codebase and our engineering practices. Review code rigorously, set conventions, and level up the engineers in your squad. Own it in production: Take real ownership of what goes live: instrumentation, alerting, and incident response for a system where physical merchants are relying on your uptime to make a living. Harness AI, stay in control: Use AI-assisted workflows to multiply your output (we invest heavily in them) while remaining in full command of every line you ship and review. Collaborate: Work day-to-day with your Engineering Manager, Product Managers, hardware vendors, and other squads to deliver seamless omnichannel payment features. Experience & Skills Required Technical Leadership: Proven experience leading technical projects, architecting complex backend systems, and guiding small teams of engineers to deliver high-quality software. Strong backend engineering: Significant commercial experience building and running production backend services. Our backend is C#/.NET, so depth there is ideal, but if you're excellent in another modern typed language and will get fluent fast, we want to hear from you. AWS in production: Hands-on experience running distributed services on AWS (ECS/Fargate, Lambda, SNS/SQS, DynamoDB or similar) and understanding the operational reality that comes with them. Distributed systems judgement: Comfortable reasoning about service boundaries, asynchronous messaging, eventual consistency, and building resilient systems that handle downstream provider outages. AI-augmented, engineer-first: You use AI coding tools effectively to move faster, but you review, understand, and take full ownership of the output. We are not looking for someone who ships code they can't explain. Fast, self-directed learner: A track record of getting productive quickly in unfamiliar domains. Enthusiasm to master the complexities of hardware-software interactions matters more to us than knowing it all on day one. Nice to Have POS & Terminal Integration: Existing experience integrating physical payment terminals, card readers, or Point of Sale (POS) systems into payment gateways. Android Experience: Familiarity with Android development, specifically in the context of building or maintaining applications for smart payment terminals. PCI-DSS & Compliance: Deep understanding of payment scheme rules, PCI-DSS compliance, EMV standards, or Point-to-Point Encryption (P2PE). Infrastructure ownership: Infrastructure-as-code (CloudFormation, CDK, or Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, and containerisation. Why Ryft? If you want to build the systems that move money in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, we'd love to hear from you. We value engineers who care about the craft, speak up with their ideas, and take pride in what they ship. You'll join a team where your voice is heard, your work matters, and there's plenty of room to grow. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer (Data)
description: About Codat Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work. You write production software, and you care about the data it moves as much as the code that moves it. This role is for an engineer who's growing fast and wants room to grow faster. You'll ship from your first weeks, own what you build once it's live, and work alongside data and AI engineers who'll push you. Codat is AI-first, not AI bolted onto SaaS, and we work that way ourselves: agents take the repetitive work, engineers take the interesting problems. What You'll Work On The data behind every answer. Services and pipelines that take raw data from accounting platforms, banks and payment systems and turn it into something a model can trust. When a source sends rubbish, your code notices. The semantic layer. The definitions the model is allowed to use: what counts as revenue, when a month ends, which currency. Get it right and every answer agrees with every other answer. The signal layer. Spotting when something changes for a client: a customer paying later, cash running tighter, a supplier quietly becoming critical. You'll help build the detection and make it fast and reliable. The tools the assistant calls. MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and APIs that serve data to agents. You'll build them, test them and find out how they break before a banker does. Keeping the numbers honest. Tests, data checks and observability that prove a number is right, and catch it the moment it isn't. You'll Probably Have Shipped production software that real people depended on, and written most of it yourself. Services, APIs or data systems with tests, not notebooks or config. Had data be the hard part. A source that sent duplicates, a schema that changed under you, two teams who meant different things by "customer". You fixed it, and you'd design it differently now. Good engineering habits in Python, C# or another general-purpose language. Tested, modular code the next person can change without fear. An eye for SQL. You can read a query and tell whether it's right, whoever or whatever wrote it. Stayed on the hook for something after it went live. You found out why it broke, fixed the cause, and added what would have caught it sooner. Some time with CI/CD, Docker and cloud (we're on Azure). You've changed a pipeline, not just pushed to one. A habit of asking why. If someone asks for a number the data can't support, you say so. AI as part of how you work, and you can explain and defend what it helped you build. Momentum. More ownership with each move, new stacks picked up quickly, things built that nobody asked for. Useful, not essential: fintech, lending or accounting; Spark, Databricks or dbt; anything that puts data in front of an LLM. Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We're more interested in what you've built and how fast you're growing than in a perfect match. How We Work We're a small team with plenty to do. Things move fast: we'd rather ship something useful and improve it than polish it in private. What you build is yours from start to finish. There's no return-to-office mandate, and you can work hybrid or fully remote. We trust you to be around when the team needs you and to deliver what you said you would. Kinly has an exciting opportunity for an experienced Senior AV Technician to join the dedicated onsite technology team supporting the prestigious London headquarters of a major global name within the fashion industry . Our client is an internationally recognised fashion brand with a significant global presence and a reputation built around quality, creativity and exceptional experiences. This is an opportunity to work behind the scenes of a business whose name and products are recognised around the world. You’ll be based within an impressive, high-profile corporate environment, supporting newly installed AV and video collaboration technology across executive, meeting and event spaces. The expectations are high. The technology, environment and service delivered to the client need to reflect the quality of the brand. The opportunity As Senior AV Technician , you’ll play a leading role within the onsite Kinly team, providing hands-on technical support while acting as a trusted point of contact for the client. Work collaboratively with IT, Facilities and other established support functions. Ensure meeting rooms, executive spaces and other priority environments are tested regularly and maintained to a consistently high standard. Carry out proactive daily system checks to identify potential issues before they affect meetings or events . Provide professional AV support for important meetings, presentations and events. Liaise with internal teams, client stakeholders, vendors, venue account managers and project managers to support the successful delivery of events. Maintain accurate technical and operational documentation. Produce monthly reporting for the Service Delivery Manager. Work with Kinly's Health & Safety team to ensure relevant RAMS documentation remains current. Identify opportunities to improve the reliability, performance and overall user experience of the AV environment. What we're looking for We're looking for someone who combines strong technical AV expertise with an exceptional approach to client service . You'll be operating within the headquarters of a prestigious global brand, so how you communicate, present yourself and respond to users is just as important as your technical ability. Ideally, you'll bring: Strong hands-on experience supporting AV and video collaboration technologies within corporate environments . Previous experience providing AV services within a large multinational or similarly high-profile organisation . Strong working knowledge of technologies from manufacturers such as Cisco, Crestron and Poly , together with broader enterprise AV technologies. The ability to independently diagnose and resolve complex AV/VC faults. Good knowledge of PCs, networking and associated corporate technology. Experience supporting executive-level meetings, presentation spaces and corporate events. Excellent communication, stakeholder-management and customer-service skills. A proactive mindset with the ability to identify potential problems before they impact users. Confidence taking ownership of AV systems and maintaining them to a high standard. The ability to remain calm and professional within a fast-moving, high-expectation client environment. Industry certifications from organisations and manufacturers such as AVIXA, Cisco, Crestron, Extron or Poly would be advantageous, although strong practical experience is equally important. The person The right person will take genuine pride in delivering an outstanding service. You'll be comfortable interacting with everyone from everyday users through to senior executives and VIP stakeholders, adapting your approach while maintaining the same consistently high standard of support. You'll also need to be comfortable joining a brand-new client environment . We need someone who enjoys taking ownership, spotting opportunities for improvement and helping establish excellent working practices rather than simply inheriting an established service. Our expectation is that you'll quickly develop a detailed understanding of the client's environment and be making a significant contribution within your first 3 to 6 months . Why join Kinly? Kinly is one of Europe's leading audiovisual and unified communications integrators and a globally trusted technology partner. For more than 25 years, we have designed, integrated and supported sophisticated workplace technology environments for leading organisations around the world. For this particular role, however, there is an extra attraction: the client . If you're an experienced AV professional looking for a role that combines technical challenge, client visibility, responsibility and the opportunity to work inside the world of global fashion , we'd love to hear from you.
